current_behavior: Ordered regular-expression keyword rules (self-explanation phrase, repository/code keywords, knowledge phrase plus identifier, companion-pipeline phrases, meeting keywords) pick the route; no LLM.

question.instructions: Decide where the companion avatar must ground its answer to this meeting chat message.

options.self_explanation: The user asks how the assistant produced its previous answer, where it got it from, or which sources that last answer used (answered from the recorded trace, no model call).
options.ananta_code_architecture: The user asks about Ananta itself: its repository, code, files, modules, classes, functions, services, endpoints, scripts, CodeCompass, hub/worker architecture, a named identifier or path, or how the companion itself works internally (voice/speech output, avatar, mouth animation, lip sync, pipeline); needs a CodeCompass lookup.
options.meet_runtime_current_dialog: The user asks about the currently running meeting or call: participants, room, chat, microphone/audio/video, what is happening right now in this conversation; this also covers questions about how Ananta Meet works (runtime context, plus code lookup when code is mentioned).
options.general_question: Smalltalk, greetings, jokes, and general world-knowledge questions that concern neither Ananta's code nor the current meeting; answered by the LLM alone without CodeCompass.

provenance: single annotator (AI assistant), synthetic paraphrases of Ananta decision situations, not reviewed by a human, evaluation only, never release evidence
